title: WWE Superstar Alexa Bliss Pops Up At Cowboys Vs. Eagles & Mavs Vs. Lakers During Christmas Weekend
htmlContent:
Bray Wyatt is without doubt one of the most creative wrestlers in the entire WWE, and many fans agree. Unfortunately, Wyatt was not used appropriately until it was released in 2021. He finally returned to WWE earlier this year and was a high point of WWE television. He also worked with Alexa Bliss a couple of years ago, and now it seems that Bliss herself said there was a void in the WWE without Wyatt.

Bray Wyatt returned at the Extreme Rules PPV and completely shocked all attendees. After his return, Wyatt managed to captivate the fans with his weird promotions and weird segments.

Speaking to BT Sport, Alexa Bliss talked about her storyline with Bray Wyatt. Bliss also testified that there was a gap in WWE when Bray Wyatt was not in the company.

“He’s such a key part of WWE and such a, you know, presence and character that it’s so great that he’s back. I feel like there was this character void and the fact that he’s back and just that creative, you need that creative energy around," said Bliss.

Speaking of Bliss she is currently in Dallas at the American Airlines Center watching the Los Angeles Lakers take on the Dallas Mavericks.

Bliss was also at the Eagles and Cowboys game on Saturday with her husband, Ryan Cabrera, which saw the Cowboys beat the Eagles 40-34.
